verdict.rationale: Authy's features page documents TouchID, PIN and password protection for access to the 2FA tokens. A community user independently reports using Face ID to protect the entire app on their phone, which corroborates app-level locking. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the app-lock behavior (e.g., lock timing/auto-lock settings, Face ID and Android biometric coverage).

support.subject: As an everyday user, the app itself locks behind biometrics or a PIN, so a borrowed phone doesn't expose my codes

citations.quote: Use TouchID, PIN protection and passwords to protect access to your 2FA tokens.
I use Authy with Face ID protecting the entire app on my phone
